summary: Backend-only verification of Custom Job -> Service visibility fix. Backend supervisor is crash-looping because /app/backend/.env is missing (KeyError MONGO_URL), so testing is done by driving custom_job_service + catalog_controller functions directly against a scratch Mongo DB (mongodb://localhost:27017). All 25 assertions pass covering: (1) convert_to_service creates service with status=active + approval_status=approved + custom_job_visibility='all', and it immediately appears in public catalog list_services and get_service for the category; (2) convert is idempotent; (3) requester_only visibility correctly stays private (not in public listing, 404 for non-owner, visible only to requesting customer); (4) one-time publish_converted_drafts() flips legacy inactive source=='custom_job' services to active+approved, is guarded by db.app_meta key='custom_job_autolive_v1' so second call returns 0, and legacy services then appear in public category listing after cache bust.

minor.issue: /app/backend/.env is missing in this pod, so supervisor backend crash-loops with KeyError: MONGO_URL. Per request this is deliberately untouched (do NOT create .env). Any live HTTP testing is blocked until .env is restored; functional testing was done in-process.

issues: Status chip currently reads 'Converted to service · Inactive' when the linked service is not active. Per the request this label should read 'Draft' instead of 'Inactive' for clarity. Non-blocking UI wording note; frontend testing was out of scope.

action_items: Restore /app/backend/.env (at least MONGO_URL and DB_NAME) so supervisor backend stops crash-looping and HTTP smoke/regression testing can run. The current pod cannot serve any /api/* request.
(Optional, from request) Update CustomJobsAdmin.jsx line ~269 label from 'Inactive' to 'Draft' and tweak toast text on line ~205 for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: convert_to_service in services/custom_job_service.py now correctly creates the service with status='active' + approval_status='approved' + custom_job_visibility default 'all', then calls on_service_activated(svc) for the requester notification. Logic verified end-to-end.

publish_converted_drafts() is correctly guarded by db.app_meta {key:'custom_job_autolive_v1'} so the migration is one-shot; it also busts catalog:services:all and site:* caches when it actually activates rows.

catalog_controller._service_visible correctly short-circuits source=='custom_job' + custom_job_visibility=='requester_only' from the public path; _private_custom_services then re-injects it only for the requesting customer. list_services and get_service both honor this.

Note: _list_all_services is cached 45s via cache_service.cached. After convert_to_service, create_service -> _after_write busts _CK_SERVICES so new rows are visible immediately. Verified in test (freshly converted service appeared in list_services without stale read).
